eligibility: Both native eleventh and twelfth initial answers must be correct after manual review, hash-bound before nonzero edits. Zero observer must exactly match native. Do not infer failure of the feature from a failed native control.
specificity: For each eligible case, apply an all-input gate-off control to its native twelfth prompt. Keep all-position and output-only effects separate from input-mediated initial-answer changes.
primary_outcome: Initial complete answer changes from the case eleventh value to its twelfth value; preserve full continuations and judge later coherence separately.
language_limits: Chinese month names contain numbers. Alphabet and Roman domains help distinguish month-name or numeral-form effects. A multilingual success alone does not establish a universal increment mechanism.
lifecycle: Preserve dashboard storage. No GPU lifecycle action without applicable authorization.
